body: my cab entry says the pasture treatment workers brushed off mustard-colored dust. not one fly remained before a cruiser waved us away.
title: cab note — on the cold night
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the mustard-colored dust while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.

title: Trailer manifest
body: I watched them seal the trailer, then ask the driver to take the family home by a route that had already closed. He asked for the children to be counted with the cargo because the passenger column was full. Nobody laughed.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
